title: Low degree terms of the Leray spectral sequence
statement:
Let $f:X\to Y$ be a morphism of schemes and $\mathcal F$ a
quasi-coherent $\mathcal O_X$-module. The low degree terms of the
spectral sequence of [pqf-lem-leray] give an exact sequence

$$
0\longrightarrow\mathrm H^1(Y,f_*\mathcal F)
\longrightarrow\mathrm H^1(X,\mathcal F)
\longrightarrow\mathrm H^0(Y,R^1f_*\mathcal F)
\longrightarrow\mathrm H^2(Y,f_*\mathcal F).
$$

In particular, if $R^1f_*\mathcal F=0$, then
$\mathrm H^1(X,\mathcal F)\cong\mathrm H^1(Y,f_*\mathcal F)$.

proof.text: The spectral sequence of [pqf-lem-leray] has $E_2^{p,q}=\mathrm H^p(Y,R^qf_*\mathcal F)$ and abuts to $\mathrm H^{p+q}(X,\mathcal F)$. Apply the generic five-term exact-sequence statement [lem-pqf-leray-five-term] to obtain the exact sequence in the item, identifying its edge and transgression maps with the canonical Leray maps via [lem-sp-grothendieck-edge-maps]. The definition of cohomology [pqf-def-cohomology] supplies the identifications of the derived-functor terms with the displayed cohomology groups. If $R^1f_*\mathcal F=0$, then $\mathrm H^0(Y,R^1f_*\mathcal F)=0$, so exactness makes the map $\mathrm H^1(Y,f_*\mathcal F)\to\mathrm H^1(X,\mathcal F)$ both injective and surjective, hence an isomorphism.
